program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # input pair L
    "itail":   (26e-6, 12e-6, 60e-6),  # tail current
    "gmid_p":  (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror / 2nd-stage gm/Id (shared -> no systematic offset)
    "L_p":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS L
    "i2":      (120e-6, 60e-6, 200e-6),# 2nd-stage current
    "L_n":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "cc":      (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 2.0e-12),
    "rz_k":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # Rz = rz_k*(1+CL/Cc)/gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail, i2, cc = p["itail"], p["i2"], p["cc"]
    gmid_bias = 14.0   # high gm/Id on current sinks -> low Vdsat (tail headroom)

    # bias: diode nfet sinking iref, mirrored to tail and 2nd-stage sink
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_bias, p["L_n"], iref, vds=0.5)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmid_bias, p["L_n"], itail, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmid_bias, p["L_n"], i2, vds=0.9)

    # input pair (vsb ~ tail node)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], itail / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.25)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], itail / 2, vds=1.0)
    # 2nd stage PMOS CS: same gm/Id and L as m3 -> same Vsg as the diode
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], i2, vds=0.9)

    rz = p["rz_k"] * (1.0 + cl / cc) / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> vinp non-inverting overall
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    # first-order predictions
    a1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * (cc + cl) + cc * cl))
    fz_den = (1.0 / m6.gm - rz)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2))
    if abs(fz_den) > 1e-12:
        fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * cc * fz_den)
        pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz))   # fz<0 (LHP) adds phase
    mp = 3 * m3.cgg  # mirror pole cap (gate of M3,M4 + drain)
    p3 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * mp)
    pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) * 0.5   # pole-zero doublet, partial effect
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + i2)
    slew = min(itail / cc, i2 / (cc + cl))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller OTA (NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror load, PMOS CS second stage, Rz-Cc compensation)
